property_summary: For every caller address A and target newOwner N, if A is not the current owner then after A calls transferOwnership(N) the owner must remain the current owner; the mutant (which removes the onlyOwner require) allows some non-owner A to change owner to N, thus violating this rule for some fuzzed (A,N).
change_summary: Remove the require check in onlyOwner so the modifier no longer enforces ownership and anyone can call transferOwnership, altering who can set owner and thus the resulting owner value.
